name: GiMiK Republik
description: Gimik Republik is a lively Filipino-themed karaoke bar and restaurant that offers an authentic and fun-filled karaoke experience. With a vibrant atmosphere, friendly staff, and a diverse song library, it stands out as a top spot for singing and socializing. The venue features a full bar, delicious Filipino food, and live bands, making it ideal for both casual nights and special celebrations. It operates late into the night, providing ample opportunity for entertainment and fun.
